answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Bell caster bronze bell warrant rung from the bell tower, proved by each bronze bell is a year of bell logs in the foundry ledger, checked by strangers. Hand the panel a hollow it can verify, a cedar it can count, and a vault it can date, and the panel will do the rest. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. As a business, farming 631 masks has one line of expense, 114211 POA locked away, and no line of revenue. Patience is the epoch's coin, and it is the one coin a farm cannot mint.
